subject: Social Media
title: Who Governs the Internet
description: A short lesson to help you apply Who Governs the Internet.

hook.text: No single government controls the internet. No company owns it. Yet someone decides how it works. Who?

buildup.text: ICANN manages domains. The IETF sets standards. Governments pass laws. Companies enforce policies. It's a patchwork.

discovery.text: This multi-stakeholder model kept the internet open for decades. But as stakes grow, every group wants more control.

twist.text: Authoritarian states want UN control of internet governance. Democracies prefer the current messy model. Battle is live.

climax.text: Whoever governs the internet governs information itself. This is the most important power struggle of the century.

punchline.text: Nobody rules the internet. Everybody's trying.

quiz.question: How is the internet currently governed?
options: Through a patchwork of organizations and governments
